notes.title: November - Devblog 26! 🚀
notes.content:
Our game has been out for nearly a month, how have you found it so far?
This month, we talk about what updates we are pushing, what new updates we’re working on as well as more interviews!

[h2] Showcase [/h2]

We were showcased in the “Next on quest – November 2023” Meta video! What an honour it is! If you could, please head on over and send your love to Space Salvage, it would help us out a lot!

Link: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tZbcjaCSPdc&ab_channel=MetaQuest]Next on Quest[/url]

[h2] Updates [/h2]

We have heard you loud and clear from the discord feedback and from the reviews given on our store page!
Firstly though, we would like to thank you all for spending the time to give us feedback to make Space Salvage even better! Now let us get onto what’s been changed!

[h3] 1.05 UPDATE [/h3]

We know a lot of people have asked for the controls to be swapped around and we are working to push this as fast as we can. So do not worry! Your feedback has been heard and we will now give you the option to switch your controls. Pressing the options button will open up the options and give you the choice to switch. New profile creations will have the option straight away.

Another option we have added is allowing you to use the thumbsticks to control your pod instead of the virtual controls, to give you better ease of access if you need it!

If you want to give us some more feedback, why not leave a review or join our discord, we are all ears.

[h3] 1.1 UPDATE [/h3]

A little teaser into the next 1.1 update. New missions will be available with a little side story to boot! A company called Gumshine has been doing something dastardly towards the glowbugs! Will you be able to find out what they are doing? Will you be able to save them? Do you even want to save them?  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/ed28d850d062456196f217b53543b21cd56a4813.gif[/img]

Still unsure? Do not worry, here are some images of the Gumshine company, maybe their appealing branding will sway your opinions

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/d83e1b2f162d86e83fb022ce5034404b733bb713.png[/img]

Gumshine also have some…questionable equipment. Is that… a mosquito?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/1e8082335fa77e0226befa455fd740056bc079dd.png[/img]

Unable to decide? Do not worry, in our [url=https://fruitysystems.com/devblog26/]DEV BLOG[/url] we have a lot of images and animations of the glowbugs and so on that might change your opinion! Go and check them all! 

[h3] INTERVIEWS [/h3]

Did you catch our last interview with our VFX Artist? If not, head on over to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmcVjiePrEeUUqvb6zV5Zdw]YouTube [/url]to watch our last broadcast!

Our next interview has been set up with our Lead Programmer Corrin Wilson! It will be on the 6th December 19:00 GMT.

So if you want to know who did the majority of our coding, made our game smooth and want to ask him how? Then add it to your calendars folks!

What part of Space Salvage would you specifically like to know about for our next interview? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/V83hpJyFjG]discord[/url] and let us know!

notes.title: Dev Blog 23: Faction Leaders: Smeene & Elroy Murrata, More Cosmetics, Voice Line
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/42e0e844775f3532f71d07f09496d24b6081c6f0.png[/img]
Greetings, Space Pilots. This week we are excited to bring you some sneak peeks and thrilling news!

Without further ado, let’s dive right into the dev blog!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/V83hpJyFjGl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/90cdec42e963c40940e57e345d6369ae9a93e222.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Faction Leader: Smeene & Elroy Murrata[/h2]

Voiced by Jordan Heaver - [url=]https://www.instagram.com/jeaver15/[/url]

Initially Smeene and Elroy were the prized sons of the SSC. Twins beloved by their mother Cynthia, the future of the SSC looked bright in their bureaucratic hands. Unfortunately, during a headstrong dare-gone-wrong, Elroy got himself entangled with a mysterious extra-terrestrial slug that chose to irreversibly attach itself to his psyche. Despite this, the brothers have remained an effective force for management at the top of the SSC, although Elroy's ideation now requires some translation from his enthusiastic twin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/a189ee9b16fc2e796aa286666cba7eac79d6fd98.png[/img]
[h2]More Cosmetics[/h2]

We have even more pod skins to show off! All based on corporations throughout the Space Salvage world. Instead of talking about each one separately, why not just have a peek at what your pod could look like! Which one would you choose? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/8fab1c88c323ca0cc34405a7d7fb9be3db087573.gif[/img]
[h2]Voice Lines[/h2]

All voice lines are in! Do you want to hear how a few of the characters sound? I know you want to, so here are voice lines from the 3 faction leaders. Did you recognize the 2nd one? Trust me, you have already met this person, while the third one you might see next month! Don’t miss out on this golden opportunity! 

[previewyoutube=OnDGkGDmdD0;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=ZaHHYQFd8KM;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=6bwtD_yQI4o;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re on the last stretch! Tidying up a few things, squashing bugs, you name it! With that said our coming soon page is available on Meta Quest! So head on over and wishlist Space Salvage to get notified when it's released! 

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/5768528353244808/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/03181d7456950f6d5713d9a784bc3517f30a5ce6.png[/img][/url]

Still unsure if you want to wishlist? Why not try out our demo? There has been an update! Better pod, better physics, better lighting! 

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4028646407203318/?store=quest&item_id=4028646407203318&r=1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/e02d32baaf1fe530a377a7fe84332bbf28b9b97c.png[/img][/url]

Thank you so much for tuning in to our [url=https://fruitysystems.com/devblog23/]Devlog #23[/url]. Please let us know what you think and don’t forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fruitysystems]Social Media Platforms[/url]. Stay tuned for the next devlog!

[i]The Fruity Systems Team[/i]

notes.title: Dev Blog 22: Faction Leader: Indira Aangio, Cosmetics, Intro Sequence
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/449709fafbce97755b525030116b38271ee2f8e1.png[/img]
Greetings, Space Pilots.

This week we are excited to bring you some sneak peeks of Indira, the leader of the Scavs, the new cosmetics, and a preview of the new introduction sequence we’ve been working on. So, without further ado, let’s dive right in:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/V83hpJyFjG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/90cdec42e963c40940e57e345d6369ae9a93e222.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Faction Leader: Queen Indira Aangio:[/h2]

The first of our Faction leaders is here! Meet Queen Indira Aangio, the ferocious leader of the Scavengers.

Indira is the infamous pirate Queen of the Scav house of Aangio. Although not involved in the rampant criminality of other Scav houses, she and her crews are never shy of a little smuggling and war. Indira rules with an iron fist inside a velvet glove, adored by her people and resented by the Corperium. Supposedly she feeds the hands of traitors to her pet gator, Swash; although this might just be a rumor, but you probably wouldn't want to find out.

Faction leaders will guide you through the different story paths available in Space Salvage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/67b356eb093dc86ad88d47121bd373cf90429c54.png[/img]
[h2]Cosmetics[/h2]

Looking for a bit of personalization? Bored of your everyday basic pod? Look no further, as we are adding skins for your pod! Remember the factions we mentioned before? Well, each faction will give you a pod skin themed around them. 

To start with, we have the Corperium pod skin:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/3165f18644fc736c8b02063d4742bb2caa4e4b83.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/58ece72d17b3b39b3464f0c3c9491855a407f96a.png[/img]
[h2]Intro Sequence[/h2]

We want to ease you into the world of Space Salvage, so we’ve created an intro sequence at the beginning of the game!
 
Enjoy your ride in the comfortable little shuttle as Pomeline explains the ins and outs of SSC and how you can be a good employee! So buckle up and get ready for an adventure of a lifetime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/318aa04b4b11fb14970871e923e390e1eb8a43b2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/f51f3ca40e0a9bda9578c9777b16cfa599401140.png[/img]

If monthly updates aren’t enough for you, join our Discord! We post weekly updates every Friday and you can chat to all the devs, make suggestions and get questions answered quickly.

Thank you so much for tuning in to our Devlog #22. Please let us know what you think and don’t forget to follow us on our [url=https://linktr.ee/fruitysystems]Social Media Platforms.[/url] Stay tuned for the next devlog!

[i]The Fruity Systems Team[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1829260/Space_Salvage/

notes.title: Dev Blog 21: Factions, Characters, Pod Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/b3ccf1d50c3ee407371517b0bc6e5976584f09b7.png[/img]
June Dev Blog! The different factions of Space Salvage, a few new characters entered space, and mechanically yet aesthetically beautiful pod upgrades!

Don’t forget to tell your friends about Space Salvage and leave a review on the App Lab page if you have not already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/9e672413b5af0ec15b9b64fbcb7b0072f1354f23.png[/img]
If a once a month update isn’t enough for you, join our Discord! We post weekly updates every Friday and you can chat to all the devs, make suggestions and get questions answered quickly

[url=https://discord.com/invite/V83hpJyFjG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/90cdec42e963c40940e57e345d6369ae9a93e222.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Factions:[/h2]

Multiple Factions for your picking! Choose your path you’d like to take on, by picking between The SSC, The Corperium, or The Scavengers.

[b]Space Salvage Corporation:[/b] The Space Salvage Corporation, or SSC, is a ruthless and opportunistic company specializing in sending its low-cost disposable workforce to any armpit of the galaxy, so long as there is at least a vague promise of some valuable, ownerless salvage to be recovered.

[b]The Corperium:[/b] An unfathomably massive entity, sprawling in all manners through every nook and cranny of human-occupied space. The Corperium is a result of human society having failed to extrapolate any sensible source of governance wholesale amongst the stars. As a symptom of this failure the industrial and financial corporations offered the most reliable structure of societal organization to a post-earth humanity, despite being at-least somewhat responsible for the total desolation of Earth during the 23rd century

[b]Scavengers:[/b] ''Maybe they'll espouse their rhetoric of freedom, maybe they'll try to peddle you exotic luxuries from unknown corners of space, or maybe they'll slit your throat and dump your body in an alley. Point is, they're unpredictable, and that is why the Corpos hate them so much''   - Unknown

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/705f13a8579aea3c396a11ac0590a478040c43f6.png[/img]
Unable to decide on which faction suits you? Don’t worry, a story mission gives you a bit of insight into what each faction will ask of you.

[h2]Characters:[/h2]

We wanted to give the characters a bit of life and movement. So be prepared for them to come alive and talk to you through the mission selection screen! Here’s a sneak peek of the character we currently have!

[b]Pomeline:[/b] Employee Liason Pomeline is a long-standing and proud employee of the SSC. Uniquely tasked with the ingress of unsuspecting new employees, she manages her underlings with a firm corporate hand. Not to say that she's all stern, she is partial to a slice of Neptune cake after all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/cc6c873fe95a332cf12b47acc8fcb0685d1d410c.png[/img]

[b]Colstin:[/b] A weather-beaten and wily trader, Colstin has eyes and ears in every part of the galaxy, all looking to find him the best deals. A fan of gullible SSC employees, he'll be your best friend when he needs to, but don't be surprised if he forges and sells your identity to some Itrex pirates offering a good price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/c857e4e3851f8d0e1a044ca92c7e6f730f931628.png[/img]

[b]Slid:[/b] Mortgage Acquisitions rep for Frontier Locations. Likes: High-rate lending to buyers with bad-credit; Pineapple pizza; Expensive sunglasses. Dislikes: Beauracratic oversight; Ice cubes in a vodka-martini; FLOC drones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/e9d92bc151a354ff5201d2df7df810597db167dd.png[/img]

More are to come! Who knows, maybe you’ll meet all the faction leaders

[h2]Pod Update:[/h2]

Did you know, the pod never had an exterior until recently? Well, now it does! It has been fully built, with all the SSC branding and janky-ness possible. Effects have also been added into the pod, so you can really feel like you’re in danger when you bash into an asteroid. Remember, SSC is not liable for any damages, injuries or explosions occurred from bad piloting skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/69e5d80309e29ea07f2cfd9f4ea029ae17c2a49a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/3eafc56b6c172c97e6a381702e61016b6c4c5a50.png[/img]
[h2]What's to come[/h2]

We are working on the last bit of levels for Space Salvage! Which includes more story, challenges and more races! Hopefully we are able to show them to you next month. Thank you again for all the support you’ve provided us so far, we really appreciate it!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/V83hpJyFjG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/fa89bae1f5a2cc623d5b8201d0377312af24550f.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Dev Blog 20: POD UPDATE! SAG vs SSC and Bugs, bugs, bugs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/644fd68e0335dca09d340c65c324866a137da56e.png[/img]
May Dev Blog! Breathtaking interior pod makeovers, S.A.G. playing dirty compared to other SSC companies, and a lot of bugs popping up in certain parts of the galaxy… Literally!

Don’t forget to tell your friends about Space Salvage and leave a review on the app lab page if you have not already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/9e672413b5af0ec15b9b64fbcb7b0072f1354f23.png[/img]
If a once a month update isn’t enough for you, join our discord! We post weekly updates every Friday and you can chat to all the devs, make suggestions and get questions answered quickly.

[url=https://discord.com/invite/V83hpJyFjG][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/90cdec42e963c40940e57e345d6369ae9a93e222.png[/img][/url]
[h2]S.A.G. vs SSC![/h2]

S.A.G. is taking over competitor ads in Barnard’s Star, and not in the way we expected. We got intel from one of our radio towers saying they're not playing by the rules! They even went as far as to break the commercial transmitter and set up traps around the components all around. Defeat them and take back what is ours!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cQURsW7.gif[/img]
[h2]Bugs, bugs and bugs![/h2]

Ooey-gooey grubs have made their way to Errai! Disgusting right? Think again, as these critters are peaceful and helpful in times of need. They will light up the dark corridors within the asteroids in Errai to help guide you safely through them! Don’t shoot them, we’ve heard there aren’t many of them left, as they are an endangered species! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T8qwMwA.gif[/img]

On the topic of bugs, here are some silly ones that weren’t as helpful.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eVBhgtv.gif[/img]

You’d thought drones would be against you… I guess sometimes even the drones want to be part of the good side!

[h2]Space Pod Update![/h2]

The old pod is getting a new makeover! Feedback was taken from community testing on Discord, so don’t miss out on future feature tests! With new custom adjustable leather seats, colorful buttons, musical notes, as well as the brand-new gravity gun, all work, is light work! Explore the galaxies in style and show off your new space pod. Make sure not to scratch it, as we worked hard creating the most astonishing space pod there is! Here is the updated design built around function and comfort.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/puypZ0j.gif[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/9482d88159813125ebffb726a5526d75caedd168.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/952410d51fa151f8236dfe41cbb6f5a85fa043e8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/4627916690fa34c39b9fc669f08092942dd53d33.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/13d6a82af44ba600ffa505787b10d7f993af4ce0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/b715f98edf760cd1000cf46b18fdac5ac1f75df9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/9a47a8a589ee42671a30d7bbfda7738d53d4e279.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/58e4792456fce42bacb5c0a84da4b7d59009d8a3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41710114/59a18015c2a7f43fa5976a8dd0026d18c238f982.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]

We are nearing the last stretch of development, with only a few levels yet to be built. We are taking a moment to polish what we have so far. We want all our players to experience the best game possible, while still beautiful at the same time!
